RUNBRIDGE AI DOCUMENTATION

API request guide

Match the request to the kind of output you need.

Request patterns below explain the integration approach. Final endpoint paths and supported parameters depend on the RunBridge launch API.

Text generation

An OpenAI-compatible chat request uses a model identifier and an ordered messages array. Streaming and tool support depend on the selected version.

{
  "model": "YOUR_MODEL_ID",
  "messages": [
    { "role": "user", "content": "Write a product introduction." }
  ]
}

Image generation

Choose an image model and provide a creative prompt. Check the model’s supported image sizes, input-image format, quality options and output format. Billing may be token-based or output-based.

Video generation

A video request may start an asynchronous job. If the endpoint returns a job identifier, follow its documented polling or callback flow. Store the identifier so a page reload does not trigger a duplicate job.

Common request considerations

01

Model identifier

Use the exact version ID from the catalog, not a display name.

02

Input compatibility

Validate file type, dimensions, prompt length and parameters against the model schema.

03

Response lifecycle

Handle immediate responses, streaming events and asynchronous jobs according to the endpoint.
